name: terminalcreature
description: A terminal pet for your statusline that evolves as your memory system grows. Native in Claude Code, Cursor CLI, Copilot CLI, Qwen Code and Droid; a turn-end card in Codex, Gemini CLI, Vibe, auggie, opencode and Amp; tmux, Starship and your shell prompt everywhere else; fed by every coding agent on the machine.
